trigger.description: The binary pack canonical JSON footer was modified after serialization, so its BLAKE3 content_hash no longer matches the header.
setup_commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/pack.eepk')
b = bytearray(p.read_bytes())
b[-21] ^= 1
p.write_bytes(b)
PY

expected_emission.repair_contains: Regenerate the binary pack from the source workspace
